dlb-project.name: Dialogue Branch Error Showcase
dlb-project.description: A dialogue project that's deliberately broken in every way we could think of — each script demonstrates one thing that can go wrong, from a missing colon in a header to a reply pointing at a node that doesn't exist. Handy for seeing exactly what the parser catches, and how; it also doubles as a real-file test fixture for packages/core. Never loaded by the Web Service itself.
